name: hfs-fragmented-metadata
purpose: Catalog and attributes B-trees formatted with tiny clumps grow into overflow extents, collapse when every record is deleted, and reuse freed nodes: the editor must follow Apple's allocation, split, collapse and reuse rules.

versionNotes.newfs: -a and -E exist only in Apple's open-source newfs_hfs built with DEBUG_BUILD; the helper is compiled from acceptance/recipes/helpers/newfs_hfs.
